assets.description: Original Canvas MediaRecorder gameplay with the Arena decision inspector, Gemini Argon 4 Medium, seed 42.
assets.source: Captured from the deployed browser Arena at 1x playback; MediaRecorder canvas capture configured for 30 fps. No audio. Separate run; no synchronized or RNG-matched comparison is claimed.
assets.policy_classification: Recorded primary zero-shot condition label; provider/model provenance limitations remain as documented.

assets.description: H.264 browser gameplay copy of the Gemini Argon 4 Medium seed 42 Arena capture.
assets.source: Transcoded from the retained WebM using ffmpeg libx264, CRF 18, yuv420p, faststart, constant 30 fps; no audio, trimming, or playback-speed increase.
assets.policy_classification: Recorded primary zero-shot condition label; provider/model provenance limitations remain as documented.
assets.conversion_command: ffmpeg -i input.webm -map 0:v:0 -an -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -fps_mode cfr -r 30 output.mp4
